item.title: Organise one day of work in a shared studio
item.context_text: A print studio has a hallway delivery at noon and two members with different tasks.
item.objective_text: Arrange the day without exposing wet prints to dust or blocking a shared route.
success_conditions: Arrange the day without exposing wet prints to dust or blocking a shared route.

children.title: Read the room notes
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: The studio can print from 9 to 1. The cutting machine must not run while prints are drying in the same room. Cart deliveries use the main hallway from noon to 12:30. Leave the hallway clear.

questions.prompt: What cannot run beside drying prints?
questions.explanation: The notes separate cutting from drying.

questions.prompt: When must the main hallway remain clear for deliveries?
questions.explanation: The cart is expected during the half-hour delivery window.

children.title: Hear the technician’s update
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: The print table by the window needs extra drying time this morning. The stockroom has a clean shelf somebody can clear. We can carry prints inside the studio to the stockroom without using the delivery hallway.

questions.prompt: Where could prints dry away from the cutter?
options: On a clean shelf in the stockroom
questions.explanation: The shelf offers a separate place to dry the prints.

questions.prompt: Why is the stockroom useful during a delivery?
options: It can be reached without entering the main hallway
It is where the cart is stored
questions.explanation: An internal route avoids interfering with the delivery.

children.title: Suggest the immediate task
children.prompt_text: You have just finished a batch. A member wants to start cutting in five minutes.
children.instructions: Tell the member what must happen first. Ask them to help clear the right shelf.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Can you clear the clean shelf in the stockroom before starting the cutting machine? We need to move all the wet prints there first. Let's use the route inside the studio.

children.title: Write the shared plan
children.prompt_text: Leave a message for the delivery and studio teams so they know which route must be kept free.
children.instructions: Give the sequence of drying and cutting, name the internal route and state the delivery window.
children.goal: Arrange the day without exposing wet prints to dust or blocking a shared route.
children.model_answer: Please move the wet prints to the clean shelf in the stockroom before anyone starts the cutting machine. Use the route inside the studio. The main hallway must stay clear from noon until twelve thirty for the delivery cart. Use the small trolley only inside the studio, and bring it back afterwards.
